description: Include Luigi as an item for unlock.
Note: Luigi's extra high jumps are currently not accounted for in logic.
The level of difficulty expected by logic.
easy: Logic wil only expect simple, often developer-intended solutions.
normal: Adds a lot of unintended but relatively easy tricks, as well as some minor skips.
hard: Requires more precise, difficult, or complex skips.

How Mario's moveset will be randomized in the multiworld.
none: Movement will not be randomized
spin_start: Mario's moves will all be randomized except for Spin
spin_progressive: All of Mario's moves will be randomized. There will be two 'Progressive Spin' items,
the first allowing ground and water spins and the second allowing spins in the air.
spin_singular: All of Mario's moves will be randomized. Spin will be a single item.
Whether Triple Jump is split into two Progressive Triple Jump items,
the first allowing Double Jumps and the second allowing Triple Jumps.
Does nothing if Movement Randomization is turned off.
Access to various different level mechanics will be randomized in the multiworld.
These include: Pull Stars, Sling Pods, Koopa Shells, Bolts and Valves, the Star Ball, Bubbles, Manta Surfing,
Floaty Fluff, Tornadoes, Bob-omb explosions, and Cannons.
Access to Powerups will be randomized in the multiworld.

off: Prankster Comets will be available from the start.
category: Prankster Comets will be randomized by type of comet.
